'''Bokguk''' is a pufferfish soup that heals {{Hp|12}} and grants {{EffectLink|Conduit Power}} for 8 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/bokguk.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Dried Kelp|Dried kelp]], a carrot, a raw [[pufferfish]], a [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] or [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], a [[Braised Mushroom|braised mushroom]] and a [[bowl]]. Picking up a pufferfish unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating bokguk takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|12}} and gives Conduit Power for 8:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
